name: Telomere Stabilization Therapy
description: Introduces lobster and Turritopsis jellyfish telomerase regulation genes to stabilize telomere length across all cell types, dramatically slowing cellular aging. The modification does not reverse existing aging but prevents further telomere degradation, effectively pausing the biological clock at the point of installation. A 30-year-old who receives the treatment will still look 30 at 60. A 60-year-old will still look 60 at 90. The treatment does not grant immortality — accumulated cellular damage, organ wear, and environmental factors still degrade health over time — but it extends functional lifespan by 50–100 years. It is the most expensive geneware modification available. It is the reason Tier 5 corporate executives look 40 at 80. It is the reason the wealth gap in Meridian 88 is also a mortality gap. The street has a saying: 'Quanta buys years.'
source_organism: Homarus americanus (American lobster), Turritopsis dohrnii (immortal jellyfish)
legality: Licensed (Helix Biosystems holds exclusive patent; black-market versions are aggressively prosecuted)
procedure: Full systemic retroviral rewrite in controlled clinical environment, 20 sessions over 12 months
side_effects: Increased cancer risk — stabilized telomeres also stabilize cancerous cells (mitigated by companion cancer immunity package)
Physical appearance diverges from chronological age, causing social complications
Immune system becomes dependent on periodic booster treatments (Φ50,000/year)
Black-market versions have 40% cancer incidence within 5 years
social_perception: The defining class marker of Meridian 88. Longevity is visible wealth. The unmodified age and die; the modified age and endure. This single modification generates more class resentment than any other technology in the city.
story_hooks: A black-market longevity treatment is circulating in Tier 2 — it works, but the cancer risk is real, and thousands of people are choosing decades of life with a coin-flip chance of terminal illness
A Tier 5 executive's longevity treatment is sabotaged during a booster session — their telomeres begin degrading at accelerated speed, aging them years in weeks
